post.description: Public. The platform limits run first (`otp.maxRequests` per `otp.requestWindowSec`, resend after `otp.resendAfterSec`, block for `otp.blockSec`); then the server sends a new code in the `Accept-Language` language. A blocked phone or a running resend countdown answers 200 with `allowed: false` and sends nothing. A number the channel cannot reach answers 422 `OTP_DELIVERY_FAILED` (the request still counts). A channel outage answers 503 `INTERNAL`.

allowed.description: A new code was sent. `false` = blocked or resend countdown running.

otpLength.description: Number of code boxes; never hardcode it in the app.

expiresInSeconds.description: Lifetime of the code just sent (`otp.codeTtlSec`); 0 when no code was sent.

blockedUntil.description: Set while the phone is blocked (UTC).

post.summary: Check the typed code and get an otpToken
post.description: Public. The right code (for this phone and purpose) is used up and answers `otpToken`. Errors: 401 `OTP_INVALID` (wrong code; `details[0].message` says how many attempts are left; the last wrong code blocks), 401 `OTP_EXPIRED` (no code, expired or already used: request a new one), 429 `OTP_BLOCKED`.

otpToken.description: Signed single-use proof for this phone and purpose. Send it as `otpToken` to the action of that purpose (login, register, change phone).

expiresInSeconds.description: Lifetime of `otpToken` (`otp.proofTtlSec`); ask for a new code after it.
